class.description: DOD NOTE: GameplayResource serves as the foundational utility base for all gameplay configuration resources (GameplayStyle, GameplayRule, GameplayMode, GameplayPerspective, GameplayDifficulty, GameplayControlMap, GameplayAccessibilityOption, and future Graphics/Audio/Network option resources). While inheriting from godot::Resource provides native Inspector authoring and .tres/.res serialization (AoS), GameplayResource bridges the gap toward our Data-Oriented Design (DOD) pipeline in three ways: 1. O(1) Interned Identity & Tag Matching: Uses godot::StringName (`resource_id`, `category`, `option_tags`, `required_tags`, `excluded_tags`) so compatibility and intersection queries compare interned pointer/hash values instead of heap-allocated String characters. 2. Declarative Rule Synthesis (`collect_rules()`): Allows any option resource to emit `GameplayRule` instances that compile into `GameplayStyle` cascades targeting the `GameEntity` and `GameProperty` hierarchy. 3. Unified ConfigFile & Dictionary I/O: Replaces ad-hoc GDScript settings boilerplate (like the TPS demo's `settings.gd` and `menu.gd`) with polymorphic `save_resource()` / `load_resource()` and `ConfigFile` serialization. Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
